taxon_unit: Frozen organism/name label; not necessarily a validated species
taxon_coverage: 100 * labels with at least one covered reference / all labels in scope
taxon_exact: 100 * labels with at least one paired zero-mismatch reference / all labels in scope
order_balanced_coverage: Arithmetic mean of within-order taxon coverage percentages, including zero-covered represented orders
order_balanced_exact: Arithmetic mean of within-order taxon exact percentages
coverage_hit: Both primers on the same accession: <=2 mismatches each, terminal 3 nt IUPAC-compatible
exact_hit: Both primers on the same accession: zero mismatches
legacy_coverage_pct: Mean within-label haplotype matching percentage; retained in original CSV for reproduction compatibility
taxonomy_limit: Frozen order labels include Aspidochirotida; they do not establish seven-order modern taxonomic coverage
